established_evidence: The existing Ansori et al. field witness directly heads Section 3.2.1 “Distribusi Normal”; the existing Astuti statistics witness heads Chapter 6 “DISTRIBUSI NORMAL”.

decision: Use the concise natural form kurva normal in running prose.

established_evidence: The established witnesses directly use both “distribusi normal baku” and “distribusi normal standar”; the Astuti witness systematically uses the former.
decision: Use distribusi normal baku; retain standar as a witnessed synonym.

established_evidence: The admitted terminology view controls mean as rata-rata.
decision: Retain rata-rata in exposition and tables; preserve the mathematical symbol mu.

established_evidence: The B012 controlled terminology and both established field witnesses support simpangan baku.
The established probability witness repeatedly uses parameter in mathematical distribution contexts.
The established witnesses directly use nilai Z for standardized normal values; skor-Z is the concise established edition form and preserves the source concept name.
decision: Use skor-Z in exposition; preserve Z notation and accept nilai Z as a synonym.

established_evidence: The admitted terminology view controls percentile as persentil, and both established witnesses use persentil directly.
decision: Retain persentil and express ordinals naturally as persentil ke-n.

established_evidence: The admitted terminology view controls distribution-shape tail as ekor.
decision: Use ekor, ekor bawah, and ekor atas.

established_evidence: Derived transparently from the admitted tail=ekor and established luas-under-curve usage.
decision: Use luas ekor; use luas daerah ekor where added clarity is helpful.

established_evidence: The established probability terminology controls probability as peluang; the witnesses use tables for normal probabilities.

decision: Use statistik uji while preserving the English index key.

established_evidence: The admitted terminology view controls random variable as variabel acak, and the established edition already uses Distribusi variabel acak as the Chapter 4 public-answer heading.
decision: Use Distribusi variabel acak for the Chapter 4 hierarchy title and the lower-case form in running prose.
